b2-22-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bad News
b2-22-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how everyone reacted when the news about the office arrived. The news was bad: everyone got sad and nobody said anything.
b2-22-01.prompt: Tell Carlos how everyone reacted to the bad news.
cues: Say what the news did to everyone
b2-22-01.target: La noticia nos puso tristes y nos quedamos callados.
b2-22-01.english: The news made us sad and we fell silent.
b2-22-01.canDo: I can use *ponerse* for a sudden change and *quedarse* for the state that stays.

b2-22-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Man Who Changed
b2-22-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about a man in the news. He studied law and became a lawyer, and with the years he has become very serious.
b2-22-02.prompt: Tell Meg what happened to the man.
b2-22-02.target: El hombre estudió derecho y se hizo abogado, pero se ha vuelto muy serio.
b2-22-02.english: The man studied law and became a lawyer, but he has become very serious.
b2-22-02.canDo: I can use *hacerse* + noun for a profession or a choice.

b2-22-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Old Station
b2-22-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what happened to the old station near the centre. The city turned it into a hotel.
b2-22-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened to the old station.
cues: Say what the station was before
Say what the city turned it into
b2-22-03.target: La ciudad convirtió la estación vieja en un hotel.
b2-22-03.english: The city turned the old station into a hotel.
b2-22-03.canDo: I can use *convertirse en* and *transformarse en* with a noun.

b2-22-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Long Road
b2-22-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about a woman in the news. She worked hard for ten years and ended up as the director of a school.
b2-22-04.prompt: Tell Meg how the woman ended up as director.
cues: Say what she ended up as
b2-22-04.target: Trabajó durante diez años y llegó a ser directora de una escuela.
b2-22-04.english: She worked for ten years and ended up as the director of a school.
b2-22-04.canDo: I can use *llegar a ser* for a result reached after a long road.

b2-22-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Speechless
b2-22-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how a man reacted when he heard the news at the meeting. He turned pale and could not say a word.
b2-22-05.prompt: Tell Carlos how the man reacted.
cues: Say that he was left speechless
b2-22-05.target: El hombre palideció y se quedó sin palabras.
b2-22-05.english: The man turned pale and was left speechless.
b2-22-05.canDo: I can choose the right verb of change by asking what kind of change it is.

b2-22-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Men and a Dangerous Gallery
b2-22-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about the story by Baldomero Lillo that you read. Two men were left without work, and then they accepted jobs in a dangerous gallery.
b2-22-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what happened to the two men in the story.
cues: Say what happened to their jobs
b2-22-consolidation.target: Los dos hombres se quedaron sin trabajo y aceptaron un puesto en una galería peligrosa.
b2-22-consolidation.english: The two men were left without work and accepted a job in a dangerous gallery.
b2-22-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short retelling of a story by Baldomero Lillo and notice the verbs of change in it.
